description: This Java class provides utility methods for URI encoding and decoding based on RFC 3986 and MIME application/x-www-form-urlencoded formats. It includes methods for encoding/decoding paths, path segments, queries, and query parameters, with special handling for certain characters and encoding types.

classes.name: UriEncoding
classes.description: A utility class for URI encoding and decoding supporting RFC 3986 and form URL encoding formats.

methods.name: encodePath
methods.description: Encodes a URI path according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodePathSegment
methods.description: Encodes a URI path segment according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a query string based on the specified encoding type.

methods.name: encodeQueryParam
methods.description: Encodes a query parameter based on the specified encoding type.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes an encoded URI string according to the specified encoding type.

methods.name: encodeFormUrlEncoded
methods.description: Encodes a string using application/x-www-form-urlencoded format.

methods.name: decodeFormUrlEncoded
methods.description: Decodes a string from application/x-www-form-urlencoded format.

methods.name: decodeRFC3986
methods.description: Decodes a percent-encoded string according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodeRFC3986UriComponent
methods.description: Encodes a string for URI components according to RFC 3986, allowing only specified characters.

methods.name: encodeBytes
methods.description: Encodes bytes into percent-encoded format, respecting allowed characters.

methods.name: isPchar
methods.description: Checks if a character belongs to the pchar set in RFC 3986.

methods.name: isUnreserved
methods.description: Checks if a character is an unreserved character in URI.

methods.name: isAlpha
methods.description: Checks if a character is an alphabetic letter.

methods.name: isDigit
methods.description: Checks if a character is a digit.

methods.name: isSubDelimiter
methods.description: Checks if a character is a sub-delimiter in URI.
